info.title: Physis triage API
info.description: Pediatric wrist fracture triage. Orders a radiologist's reading queue by risk; it does not diagnose, and the absence of a box is not evidence of the absence of a fracture.

get.description: Public and deliberately thin. Model provenance is on the authenticated response, which carries model_version.

post.summary: Score a study and localize fractures
post.description: Fetches each presigned image URL, scores it, aggregates the study score as the maximum over its images, and returns the age-band percentile. Triage and notification only: this does not diagnose.

415.description: Fetched, but not a decodable image

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
One envelope for every failure.

The client branches on `success` and never reads the HTTP status, so a body
that only sets a status would be read as a success with missing fields.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description:
Public and deliberately thin.

Provenance belongs on the authenticated response, where `model_version` and
`model` already carry it. An unauthenticated endpoint has no reason to name
the checkpoint that is loaded.

triage_score.title: Triage Score
triage_score.description: Study score: the maximum over the study's images

age_band.title: Age Band
age_band.description: Which population the percentile is against

image_id.title: Image Id
image_id.description: Unique within the study; echoed back

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Presigned HTTPS URL the service fetches. Never persisted, never logged

view.title: View
view.description: Projection. UNKNOWN maps to the trained unknown embedding

triage_score.title: Triage Score
triage_score.description: Calibrated probability for this image alone

valid_patch_fraction.title: Valid Patch Fraction
valid_patch_fraction.description: Share of the 384x384 canvas that is not padding. Well under 0.5 means a badly cropped upload and a score resting on few patches

boxes.title: Boxes
boxes.description: Fracture boxes as [x0, y0, x1, y1, score] in the pixel space of the uploaded image. An empty list means the detector ran and returned nothing; null means this deployment cannot localize. The absence of a box is not evidence of the absence of a fracture

study_id.title: Study Id
study_id.description: The unit the worklist is ordered by

age_years.title: Age Years
age_years.description: Patient age in years. Required, with no default: it selects the age band the percentile is computed against
